title: Defining and calling a greeting
description: You can track when a saved function body actually runs.

steps.description: def gives greet a body containing two print calls. You save that body for later calls rather than execute it here.
The first displayed line is About to greet. Execution has reached the statements after the definition.

steps.question: How many times will the welcome message appear?
steps.answer: Twice. Each of the two greet calls runs both prints in the function body.

steps.description: You see the greeting pair twice, followed by Done greeting. Each call finishes before the next top-level statement runs.
